raw_response:
This plot is very small, just a tiny piece where I plant my yam and some cassava mixed together. I own the land so I take care of it well, and I put the manure from my goats and the kitchen ash on it — that is what my father did and the yams come out well. I went to school small-small, so I know fertilizer helps, but for yam on this tiny piece I trust the manure more, and buying a whole bag of NPK for 0.05 hectare is wasting money when my other plots need it more. I use my own yam setts from last harvest like everybody here, and my wife and children help me with the weeding and mounding — I no need to hire anybody for this small ground.
